candidate.title: Rep. Ilhan Omar’s lawyers say authorities ignored judge’s restrictions on home search - The Washington Post
candidate.description:
Lawyers for Rep. Ilhan Omar (D-Minnesota) on Friday accused federal authorities of ignoring key restrictions that a judge placed on the search of the lawmaker’s D.C. residence this week and demanded the immediate return of all property seized from the home.
